en: Hm. Is there really no tailor in Gensokyo that could make my daughter a suit?
Seems to be for some important event too... She was lamenting about it being torn.
Hecatia's wardrobe isn't exactly helping either.
Well then, there is one person left that I could ask...
My? What business do you seek here?
Do you not hate us Lunarians? I heard of the stories.
That is for later. I just need something from you.
"Help me, Eirin," you say? I get asked for help a lot, you know.
What are you in need of? All my medicine are tailor-made, for your information.
I'm a spirit. Do you think I look sick?
In the head, sure.
Okay, now.
Look, all I wanted to know is if you know any place to tailor a suit.
Eh? For whom?
For Reisen.
Ah, so you are the one who she has been staying with recently
Surprising, coming from you.
Yet my care for her are more tailored to her than you ever did.
Wow, okay.
Well, anyways, the suit is made in the Lunar Capital. Gensokyo does not really have this type of fashion.
I was afraid that it had to come to that. Oh well.
That's the person I was talking about.
Eh? Visitors? What are you doing here~?
What are *you* doing here? Is this not Doremy's place?
She went on vacation.
Look, I just need to get to the Lunar Capital.
(Also, is this not her place?)
Since you come to our place, you must play with us first~
Yea- wait what.
That's a whole vengeful spirit that is NOT a human we're dealing with.
Whatever, lets just get this over with.
Wahh... what was that for? I just said playing not actual fighting...
That danmaku is made for killing a person!
Yes, that is what I call it.
Now will you let me pass? I need to get a tailor as soon as possible.
A tailor...? Do you need something tailor-made?
Dreams are tailor-made to each person's mind too, you know.
I am a tailored maid if that counts
Good grief, I am leaving.
